height_basis: Footprints are OSM building ways, used unmodified. Heights are almost all estimated: only 3 ways carry a height tag and 15 carry building:levels. The rest use a deterministic rule on footprint area and building type (2-14 levels at 3.2 m). No individual building's height in this scene is a measurement.

carriageway_overlap.rule: A building footprint covering at least 20 m of drivable lane centreline is not drawn. Buildings have no vertical placement in this project, so such a footprint would be extruded from the ground through the carriageway.
carriageway_overlap.data_class: PUBLICLY_SOURCED_DATA (footprints); the exclusion is a rendering rule

carriageway_clip.rule: Every footprint is trimmed where it overlaps the drivable surface — each lane's own shape widened to its own width plus a 0.75 m margin, plus the junction shapes. Buildings have no vertical placement in this project, so an untrimmed overlap is a wall standing in a traffic lane.
carriageway_clip.margin_basis: SUMO puts a vehicle on the lane centreline; the widest body here is 2.5 m, so it reaches 1.25 m out inside a >=3.2 m lane. The margin is the tolerance beyond the lane edge and covers a long body's corner on a junction curve.
carriageway_clip.data_class: PUBLICLY_SOURCED_DATA (footprints); the trim is a rendering rule
